name: Public Service Gate
description: Handles WhatsApp public-user safety and admin-managed member access control before agent dispatch.

siblingLineGuardEnabled.description: Bound how much the bot's two WhatsApp lines may say to each other (default true). They auto-reply, so one DMing the other loops forever; see lib/sibling-lines.js.

whatsappLines.description: Map of channels.whatsapp account id to the number that line uses, e.g. {"default": "+263...", "ads": "+263..."}. Needed to tell admin self-chat (sender is the receiving line's own number) from one line DMing another. Operator data: like botWhatsappNumber the live value is preserved when the config template is applied.

siblingLineMaxEventsPerWindow.description: Messages the two lines may exchange inside one window before the pair is held (default 8).

siblingLineWindowSeconds.description: Sliding window length for the sibling-line budget, in seconds (default 900).

siblingLineCooldownSeconds.description: How long the pair stays held after it spends its window budget, in seconds (default 21600).

siblingLineMaxBurstsPerDay.description: Times per UTC day the pair may spend its budget before being held until tomorrow (default 3).
